concept: One choice from a few options that each need a sentence, drawn as small panes, the chosen one chosen glass with a check.

default_to_avoid.pattern: big bordered boxes with a coloured border on the selected one (pricing cards) as the radio cards
default_to_avoid.kind: radio cards, choice cards, option cards, plan picker
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured border is a hue and a single cue; the choice must be a shape and a mark too

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: each card is a level-2 surface inside the pane; the chosen one lifts as chosen glass

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the chosen card carries a check in its corner, a mark and not only a colour

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: arrow keys move between cards and choose, like any radio group

options: A level-2 cards, chosen glass with a check
variants.picked: A level-2 cards, chosen glass with a check
variants.reason: A uses the stack and adds a mark (P6). B is a colour cue only. C works but loses the room a plan or a speed needs.

root.why: the question above the cards, the same in every theme and on every scene

legend.why: the question in the label size, the group’s name

grid.why: the cards in a grid that wraps before a card gets narrower than its title

c2.why: two cards per row when there are two or four choices

c3.why: three cards per row when there are three or six choices

card.why: a level-2 surface with the faint edge, a 44px-plus target

head.why: the title and the mark on one line

title.why: the option’s name in the body size, semibold

mark.why: a ring that fills with the loud solid and a check when chosen

check.why: the check inside the mark, the same in every theme and on every scene

description.why: a line or two in secondary text that helps the reader choose

hover.why: a card lightens under the pointer at hover pace

data-state=checked.why: the chosen card is chosen glass with its mark filled

data-disabled.why: a disabled card uses the shared disabled opacity

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring round the focused card

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the cards and the chosen one

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

data-pane-card.why: inside a Card the card glass already blurs and dims the scene, so this drops its own filter and stays the inner level

data-pane-surface.why: inside any other pane that marks itself a surface it likewise drops its own filter and stays the inner level

background-color.why: the card tint eases at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
